chapter: Moving, Columbia Missouri and leaving home
title: Boy Scouts at twelve
summary: He joined the Boy Scouts at twelve and credits it with lessons in preparedness that shaped his life and music.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: And in the period -- I might add, this might be important too. I was a boy scout during the same period, at the age of 12. That's when you become a boy scout.

See, you might say that the magic figure in my life might be 12, you know. Because I joined the boy scouts, and there again I learned some of the fundamentals of the American way of life that was taught, the male section of the society. And I was taught all of the things that a boy scout is taught. Number one, be prepared, you know, and learning how to make fires, and all of the things that go with being a boy scout, which I think are significant in my life and in my music.
And I'm very proud to have been a part of these things and --
